name: Life of Pix · Nature

title.zh: Life of Pix · 按主题看照片

description.zh: 看Nature图库实际渲染的具体风光照片。 Life of Pix提供按主题浏览的摄影照片，Galleries以自然、城市、美食等封面引向对应图库。自有照片在custom版权条款下可免费用于合规商用，竞争图库、原样转售与批量分发受限，第三方合作商品和人物、品牌等权利另核。
description.en: Life of Pix presents photography through themed galleries, including nature, city and food. Its own photos are available for free commercial use under a custom copyright license with restrictions on competing libraries, unmodified resale and mass distribution. Affiliate products and independent rights involving people or brands remain separate.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Life of Pix (https://www.lifeofpix.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Nature图库实际渲染的具体风光照片。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看黑白摄影首屏，再对照Galleries完整露出的自然、城市和美食封面，随后看Nature页的湖岛、森林石阶与山坡实照。这里展示的是图库里的真实照片，截图中未显示逐张署名或下载控件，本次也未下载验原图。适合挑选风光配图，自有图库可免费合规商用，须遵守禁止竞争库、原样转售与批量分发等限制，合作商品及人物、品牌权利另核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
